movementFamilies.name: TMI NH35A
movementFamilies.plainLanguage: Shows the time and the date. It winds itself as you wear it, can also be wound by the crown, and the seconds hand stops when you set the time so you can set it precisely.

movementFamilies.plainLanguage: Adds a fourth hand that tracks a second time zone over 24 hours, alongside the date. Useful if you travel, or keep time with someone abroad.

seo.description: An independent watch atelier in Egypt. Compose your own automatic watch, part by part, or choose a finished NIVORÉ build.

care.title: Caring for your timepiece
care.body:
Wear it often; an automatic movement winds as you move.

Unless your documentation states otherwise, keep it away from water.

Avoid strong magnetic fields and hard knocks.

Have it serviced by a qualified watchmaker.

hero.headline: Defined by Detail.
hero.body: Automatic watches composed one part at a time in our atelier in Egypt. Choose a finished piece, or compose your own.

intro.headline: An independent atelier for considered timepieces.
intro.body: NIVORÉ builds automatic watches one at a time, selecting each case, dial, hand set and strap for how they work together on the wrist.
intro.body2: Our pieces are custom builds around proven third-party automatic movements and selected aftermarket components. We name every part, and we never claim what we have not earned.

process.title: Choose a movement
process.body: Date, day-date, time only or a second time zone. We explain each in plain words.

process.title: Compose the watch
process.body: Dial, case, hands, bezel and strap. Only parts that fit together are offered.

process.title: We assemble it
process.body: Your watch is assembled and checked in the atelier, then presented with its certificate of composition.

craft.eyebrow: The quiet part of the work
craft.headline: Every part is chosen for how it sits beside the others.

points.title: Proportion
points.body: Case diameter, lug-to-lug and hand length are recorded for every part, and the builder draws them to scale.

points.title: Honesty
points.body: Movements and components are named as supplied by their makers. Nothing is described as more than it is.

points.title: Restraint
points.body: We add only what improves the piece. Fewer details, each given full attention.

packaging.headline: Presented as carefully as it was made.
packaging.body: A cream rigid box with a taupe lining, an ivory sleeve, and a certificate of composition listing every part of your watch.

ordering.title: Order
ordering.body: Add a finished piece or your composition to the bag. No account is needed.

ordering.title: Pay
ordering.body: Cash on delivery or InstaPay transfer. Transfers are confirmed by the atelier by hand.

ordering.title: Assembly
ordering.body: We prepare the components and assemble your watch. You can check its status at any time.

ordering.title: Delivery
ordering.body: Your watch is delivered across Egypt, with its certificate and care card.

collectionBanner.headline: Timepieces
collectionBanner.body: Finished compositions from the atelier. Each can be ordered as it is, or opened in the builder and made your own.

atelier.headline: We believe a watch should be noticed slowly.
paragraphs: In the balance of a dial. In the weight of a crown under the thumb. In a strap that softens with wear.
NIVORÉ is an independent watch atelier based in Egypt. We build automatic timepieces one at a time, selecting each case, dial, hand set and strap for how they work together on the wrist.

Our watches are custom builds around proven third-party automatic movements and aftermarket components. NIVORÉ is independent and is not affiliated with, or endorsed by, the makers of those movements.
We choose fewer details and give each one our full attention. We make watches for people, not for a type of person.

values.title: Proportion
values.body: Every element is sized against the others, from case diameter to the width of a hand.

values.title: Honesty
values.body: We name movements and components clearly and never claim what we have not earned.

values.title: Restraint
values.body: We add only what improves the piece.

values.title: Intimacy
values.body: Each watch is assembled for one wearer. Conversation comes before transaction.

values.title: Openness
values.body: Designed for every wrist. Collections are defined by size and character, never gender.

faq.a: No. NIVORÉ is an independent watch-modification atelier. We build watches around third-party movements and aftermarket components, and we are not affiliated with, authorised by, or endorsed by Seiko or any movement maker.

faq.q: What is a custom or modified watch?
faq.a: A watch assembled from individually chosen parts: a movement, dial, case, hands, crystal, bezel and strap. We select each part and assemble the watch in our atelier.

faq.q: Do I need an account to compose a watch?
faq.a: No. You can compose, save on this device, share a link and order as a guest.

faq.q: How does the builder know parts fit?
faq.a: Every part has recorded measurements and fitments. The builder only offers parts that fit together, and parts whose fit has not been confirmed are not offered until we check them.
Cash on delivery, or an InstaPay transfer. InstaPay orders stay pending until we confirm the transfer has arrived. We never ask for card details.
Our warranty terms are being finalised and will be published here before we accept orders. Please ask us if you need details now.
Unless your documentation states otherwise, keep it away from water. We do not quote water-resistance figures that we have not tested.

footer.disclosure: NIVORÉ is an independent watch atelier. Our watches are built around third-party automatic movements and aftermarket components, named as supplied by their makers. NIVORÉ is not affiliated with or endorsed by any movement maker, including Seiko.
